pattern_explanation: Both languages borrowed these words from the same international sources, so the spellings look alike. Over time the meanings drifted apart in Turkish, so each word now means something different from its English look-alike.
false_friend_warning: Students may think these Turkish words mean 'sympathetic', 'local', 'eventual' or 'college' because the spelling looks similar, but their real meanings are likeable, pub, possible and high school. Check the meaning before translating word for word.
